The Wandering Isle is the starting area of the playable pandaren in Mists of Pandaria. It is a massive island on the back of a giant turtle named Shen-zin Su, which is inhabited by curious pandaren and/or their descendants who left their homeland of Pandaria centuries after the Great Sundering, in order to discover the other lands and races of Azeroth. The Isle has been weaving about the world's oceans ever since.
After the Burning Legion destroyed the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit, the monks of the Order of the Broken Temple relocated to the Wandering Isle.

The moving isle's inhabitants are the descendants of a rare breed of pandaren: explorers who left their mist-shrouded homeland behind in search of knowledge and adventure.|''[[The Art of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria]]'', pg. 32}} '''The Wandering Isle''' is the starting area of the playable [[pandaren (playable)|pandaren]] in {{g|mop}}. It is a massive island on the back of a [[giant turtle]] named [[Shen-zin Su]],[http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/mists-of-pandaria/pandaren/ Meet the Pandaren] which is inhabited by curious [[pandaren]] and/or their descendants who left their homeland of [[Pandaria]] centuries after the [[Great Sundering]],[[The Ballad of Liu Lang (quest)]] in order to discover the other lands and races of [[Azeroth]]. The Isle has been weaving about the world's oceans[[Pandaren (playable)#Opening cutscene]] ever since. After the [[Burning Legion]] destroyed the [[Peak of Serenity]] in [[Kun-Lai Summit]], the [[monk]]s of the [[Order of the Broken Temple]] relocated to the Wandering Isle. ==History== ===Origins=== {{Stub/Lore-section}} [[File:Shen-zin Su - Pearl of Pandaria.jpg|thumb|[[Shen-zin Su]] as seen in ''[[Pearl of Pandaria]]''.]] The descendants of [[Liu Lang]]'s followers, whom [[Shen-zin Su]] would dub the "grandchildren" of Liu Lang, still travel on the great turtle's shell to see the world. The turtle has continued to grow since Liu Lang's time to a truly massive size, supporting several villages, forest, and small mountain ranges. The settlers would appropriately call the sea turtle's shell the "Wandering Isle". Ever since [[Wugou]], the spirit of earth, fell asleep, the dirt of the [[Dai-Lo Farmstead]] started drying out and got harder and harder to get new seeds to sprout.[[Still Good!]] Some daring pandaren explorers such as [[Chen Stormstout|Chen]] and [[Li Li Stormstout]] left the Isle to explore the greater world.[[Lorewalker Amai#History lesson]] ===Mists of Pandaria=== {{mop-section}} In Year 30 [[ADP]], [[Shen-zin Su]] was swimming as usual in the seas, until the [[Alliance]] ''[[Skyseeker]]'' gunship crashed into his flank because of the thick mist.[[None Left Behind]] This injured the giant turtle and caused him to no longer swim straight,[[The Suffering of Shen-zin Su]] dragging him toward the [[Maelstrom]]. The island inhabitants felt the change and populations who usually kept to themselves, such as the local Amberleaf [[sprite]]s[[Items of Utmost Importance]] and [[Fe-Feng tribe]] of [[hozen]], understood something bad was coming, so they started giving trouble to the local [[pandaren]], notably by stealing their supplies.[[The Way of the Huojin]] Sensing that something was abnormal, [[Master Shang Xi]] gave his disciples, [[Ji Firepaw]] and [[Aysa Cloudsinger]], the task of finding and unite the four ancient [[Pandaren spirit|elemental spirits]], which would help the pandaren talk to Shen-zin Su, a feat not done in centuries.[[The Passion of Shen-zin Su]] Realizing that the source of Shen-zin Su's pain was the ''Skyseeker'', Master Shang Xi's disciples headed into the forbidden [[Pei-Wu Forest]].[[Bidden to Greatness]] There, the party helped triage members of the [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]], as well as fend off the [[Deepscale tribe|Deepscale]] [[saurok]] from the depths.[[Evil from the Seas]][[An Ancient Evil]] With the immediate threat taken care of, [[Ji Firepaw]] decided to blow up what was left of the ''Skyseeker'',[[Risking It All]] and shockingly, this plan actually worked to a point.[[The Healing of Shen-zin Su]] ===Legion=== {{Legion-section}} During the [[third invasion of the Burning Legion]] in 32 ADP, [[demon]]ic forces led by [[Lady Keletress]] attacked the [[Peak of Serenity]] in [[Kun-Lai Summit]], while the Wandering Isle happened to be traveling nearby.[[Before the Storm (quest)]] Overwhelmed, the monks evacuated to the island and settled at the [[Temple of Five Dawns]], where they founded the [[Order of the Broken Temple]] under the leadership of their new [[Adventurer|Grandmaster]].[[The Dawning Light]] When a [[Legion ship|Legion command ship]] appeared on the horizon, it was encountered by the monk champions who defeated its commander, [[Adjunct Telios]], before she could attack the residents of the Wandering Isle.[[Impending Danger]] Lady Keletress eventually launched her last assault against the Broken Temple, with her demonic army invading the back of the great turtle. However, with the power of the Storm Brew, the Grandmaster managed to slay her, while the demons were driven away by the monks.[[Storm Brew]] At some point, [[Varagol the Coercer]] poisoned the [[Celebration Brew]] and sent it to the isle, in order to weaken the Broken Temple.[[A Brewing Situation]] With the help of [[Brewer Almai]], and the spirit of [[Brewmaster Blanche]], a cure was eventually made and the affected monks were able to recover from the [[fel]] poison.[[A Time for Everything]] ===Pandaren Heritage=== {{tww-section}} Centuries after he left Pandaria, Shen-zin Su returned to the waters near his home during the [[Spirit Festival]] held by the pandaren who lived on him.[[This Was Home]] ==Descriptions from site== [[File:Wandering Isle.jpg|thumb|The Wandering Isle in ''[[Mists of Pandaria Expansion Features/Welcome to Pandaria|Welcome to Pandaria]]''.]] ;From the zone listing: :''Separated from Pandaria for millennia, the Wandering Isle meanders the oceans of Azeroth. When the weather changes unexpectedly on the Isle and it begins erratically spiraling toward the [[Maelstrom]], the elders at the [[Temple of Five Dawns]] request the aid of four elemental spirits to unravel the mystery. Heroes must figure out the cause of the land's illness before the entire island plunges into the abyss!''[http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/mists-of-pandaria/feature/zone Mists of Pandaria-Zones] ;From the Pandaren Starting Zone Cinematic: :''Though Pandaren live in harmony with their native land, wanderlust has gripped a small portion of their hearts for as long as they can remember. To satisfy that wanderlust, the ancient scholar Liu Lang set out long ago – on the back of a turtle – to explore the world he knew waited beyond Pandaria’s shores. Liu Lang made several return trips to his homeland, each time bringing with him stories of the wondrous things he’d seen; each time, Shen-zin Su, the turtle that carried Liu Lang through the waters, seemed to become larger and larger. :''Liu Lang has passed on, but his followers still depart Pandaria's shores to see the world. The turtle has grown massive, the size of a small city. It’s here, on the "Wandering Isle" that young, eager Pandaren train and learn, engaging in mock combat against one another and mastering the tools and forms of martial arts. :''Life on the Wandering Isle is pacific and enlightening until the day the Wandering Isle travels through the seas near Azeroth’s Maelstrom. The ground becomes unstable, crops wilt, and Shen-zin Su seems to wobble in the ocean, drifting in an unsteady pattern that may be a death spiral. :''As one of the most promising Pandaren wanderers, you’ll uncover the true threat to the Wandering Isle. But the problem facing the great turtle has several potential solutions, and the students of the isle are split on how to handle it. Do they act immediately (but rashly) to save their home before all is lost? Do they deliberate, attempting to find a safer (but slower) way to heal the land and deal with the dangers in their midst? :''Your decision will shape the future, and set the path of the Pandaren in a changed world. ;From the zone article :''[[Liu Lang]] has passed on, but his followers still depart Pandaria's shores to see the world. The turtle has grown massive, the size of a small city. It’s here, on the "Wandering Isle" that young, eager Pandaren train and learn, engaging in mock combat against one another and mastering the tools and forms of martial arts.'' :''Life on the Wandering Isle is pacific and enlightening until the day the Wandering Isle travels through the seas near Azeroth's [[Maelstrom]]. The ground becomes unstable, crops wilt, and Shen-zin Su seems to wobble in the ocean, drifting in an unsteady pattern that may be a death spiral.'' :''As one of the most promising Pandaren wanderers, you'll uncover the true threat to the Wandering Isle. But the problem facing the great turtle has several potential solutions, and the students of the isle are split on how to handle it. Do they act immediately (but rashly) to save their home before all is lost? Do they deliberate, attempting to find a safer (but slower) way to heal the land and deal with the dangers in their midst?'' :''Your decision will shape the future, and set the path of the Pandaren in a changed world.''[http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/mists-of-pandaria/zone/the-wandering-isle The Wandering Isle] ;From the information on the pandaren: :''It is the rare pandaren indeed who sought a way beyond the mist. Generations ago, pandaren explorers began to gather on the back of a giant turtle: Shen-zin Su. The great sea turtle roamed Azeroth's oceans, perhaps the only contact pandaren had with the outside world. Eventually, they too lost contact with their mist-shrouded homeland.'' :''Players who choose to create a pandaren character will start their journey on the back of [[Shen-zin Su]]. When the great turtle is threatened, and their whole wandering homeland is in jeopardy of being swallowed by the sea, players will have to accelerate their training and spring into action.'' :''During their time on the turtle, players will first encounter the Alliance and Horde. Before they are finished, they'll have to make the most important decision of their lives: Which of the two factions will they support as they venture out to heal a world broken by the Cataclysm and threatened by a global war?'' ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Wandering Isle.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Wandering Isle.]] [[File:VZ-Temple of Five Dawns.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Wandering Isle when housing the [[Order of the Broken Temple]].]] {| class="darktable hlist" | *[[Cave of Meditation]] *[[Chamber of Whispers]] *[[Dawning Span|The Dawning Span]] *[[Dawning Stair|The Dawning Stair]] *[[Dawning Valley|The Dawning Valley]] *[[Elders' Path|The Elders' Path]] *[[Fe-Feng Village]] *[[Fu's Pond]] *[[Liang's Retreat]] *[[Mandori Village]] **[[Stormstout Inn]] *[[Morning Breeze Lake]] *[[Morning Breeze Village]] *[[Pei-Wu Forest]] **[[Forlorn Hut]] **[[Pool of the Paw]] *[[Ridge of Laughing Winds]] *[[Rows|The Rows]] **[[Dai-Lo Farmstead|The Dai-Lo Farmstead]] **[[Ki-Han Brewery]] **[[Teeming Burrow]] **[[Virmen Grotto]] *[[Shang Xi Training Grounds]] *[[Shrine of Dreaming Stones]] *[[Shrine of Five Dawns]] *[[Shrine of Inner-Light]] *[[Singing Pools|The Singing Pools]] **[[Pool of Reflection]] *[[Temple of Five Dawns]] **[[Hall of the Seasons]] **[[Hall of the Twin Brothers]] **[[Terrace of Clear Thought]] **[[Lingering Clouds Peak]] *[[Tranquil Grotto]] *[[Valley of Sighs]] *[[Wood of Staves|The Wood of Staves]] *[[Wreck of the Skyseeker]] *[[Wu-Song Village]] |} {{clear|left}} ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="darktable" |- ! Access |- | [[Stormwind City]], [[Elwynn Forest]] || {{Alliance}} || Concluding [[A New Fate]] |- | [[Orgrimmar]], [[Durotar]] || {{Horde}} || Concluding [[A New Fate]] |} Once characters leave the Wandering Isle, they are ineligible for a return journey. Non-pandaren are prevented from ever entering this version of the island, much like the [[Lost Isles]] and [[Kezan]] were only part of the leveling experience of [[goblin]] characters. [[Monk]]s of all races later establish the Wandering Isle as their [[Class Hall]] for the [[Order of the Broken Temple]]. This version of the Isle exists in a separate phase, not interfering with the pandaren starting experience. Notably, the [[Wreck of the Skyseeker]] is absent from the new version of the map. After completing the pandaren [[heritage armor]] questline with a pandaren character on your account, non-pandaren can travel to the island by taking a hot-air balloon from Stormwind or Orgrimmar. ==Notable characters== {{seealso|The Wandering Isle NPCs}} *{{RaceIcon|Pandaren|Male}} {{NPC||Master Shang Xi}} *{{RaceIcon|Ji}} {{NPC||Ji Firepaw}} *{{RaceIcon|Aysa}} {{NPC||Aysa Cloudsinger}} ==Quests== {{main|Wandering Isle storyline}} The [[Wandering Isle storyline]] is the [[pandaren (playable)|pandaren]] level 1-10 starting experience. Freshly-created pandaren start out ''neutral'', in their own instance.
